Subject: Invoice dispatch and VAT proof for Q3 contract

Hi Kimberly,

We're finalizing our AP intake for Q3 and have a couple of constraints on our side: Greenleaf requires structured invoice payloads (XML over SFTP) for automated posting into our ERP. We do not plan to enroll in third-party portals for the next 6 months — portal onboarding is a longer procurement cycle for us.

Can Redwood support: 1) primary delivery as XML over SFTP, and 2) a PDF copy via email to finance_ops@greenleaf.com as a secondary copy? Also, we need a sample XML payload and schema to validate with our ERP team (Xero importer). Finally, please confirm the remit party/name that will appear on the invoice and whether Redwood will include VAT registration information in the XML fields.

FYI attached is our PO reference so you can map the invoice to it (PO_78934.pdf).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

—Jamie
AP Manager
Greenleaf Therapeutics

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear note and the PO. We can support the flow you described. Proposed approach: 

- Primary: deliver machine-readable invoice XML to your SFTP endpoint (we'll work with your SFTP admin for credentials and directory layout).
- Secondary: send a PDF copy to finance_ops@greenleaf.com (email copy only, no portal enrollment required).
- VAT: we will populate VAT fields in the XML and include the invoice-level VAT breakdown. Please confirm Greenleaf's VAT number and whether reverse-charge applies for any of the entities on the PO.

I've attached a simple XML sample and a minimal schema to illustrate the fields we emit (invoice_XML_sample_v1.xml, xml_schema_sample.xsd). The sample uses the "Redwood Payments" remit name; if you require the legal entity name and address to match Greenleaf-specific remit routing, let us know the exact remit party to display.

If you cannot accept SFTP onboarding immediately, we can temporarily enable a signed SFTP exception (approved_exception_form.pdf) and send nightly pushes until your ERP team is ready. That exception requires AP approval (your side) and our finance sign-off; Connor O'Brien on my team will be the exception approver and will loop Marissa for collection/terms if needed.

Next steps I propose: 
1) You confirm VAT number and remit name.
2) If SFTP is OK, provide test credentials and preferred test window.
3) If not, confirm acceptance of the exception flow (signed by your AP lead).

Happy to schedule a 20-min call to walk the XML sample with your ERP specialist.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Billing Program Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: invoice_XML_sample_v1.xml, xml_schema_sample.xsd)
